model: signal → provenance → allowed claim → confidence → limitations
combinedAuthorityRule: A combined figure never inherits more authority than its weakest supporting evidence. Ledger publishes no universal or combined skill, quality, or employability score.

signals.provenance: Collector-derived from provider-reported usage in local logs.
signals.allowedClaim: AI-assisted activity occurred on a given calendar day.
establishes: That AI tooling was used on that day

signals.provenance: Provider-reported usage accounting, deduplicated at the event level.
signals.allowedClaim: A quantity of model usage was accounted for.

signals.provenance: Ed25519 signature by a device key, verifiable in the browser.
signals.allowedClaim: This record was produced by a specific device key and has not been altered since.
doesNotEstablish: that the source logs were genuine

signals.provenance: Local filesystem/git scan on the member’s own machine.
signals.allowedClaim: A project is present and active on the member’s machine.
doesNotEstablish: that the linked URL is that project

signals.provenance: A statement signed by the device key, published by the member under an external account (e.g. a public GitHub gist), fetched and verified in the browser.
signals.allowedClaim: The holder of this signing key also controls the named external account.
establishes: Control of the linked account is tied to the signing key
doesNotEstablish: that the external account itself is genuine or belongs to a real named person

signals.provenance: Imported from a version-control host (planned adapter).
signals.allowedClaim: A change authored under an identity landed in a repository.

signals.provenance: Version-control history tracked over time (planned; see DURABILITY_SPEC.md).
signals.allowedClaim: A landed change survived N days without revert, rewrite, or hotfix.
establishes: That a change persisted for a measured window
Absence of corrective rework in that window
doesNotEstablish: that stability was caused by the change

signals.provenance: A defined assessment run under stated conditions (planned).
signals.allowedClaim: A performance level was achieved on a specific benchmark under stated conditions.
establishes: Performance on that benchmark, on that date

signals.provenance: An attestation from a named external party (planned).
signals.allowedClaim: A named party confirmed a specific claimed outcome.
establishes: That a specific outcome was confirmed by that party

signals.provenance: Entered by the member. Not verified.
establishes: That the member made the claim

note: Read a profile bottom-up: each badge maps to a signal here, and the badge can support only that signal’s allowed claim at its stated confidence. Combining badges does not raise their authority.
